reference_solution.expected_approach: Use a hash map to store previously seen values and their indices.
reference_solution.why: The hash map allows the solution to check whether the required complement has already been seen while traversing the array.
detailed_explanation: Traverse the array from left to right.
For each current value, calculate the complement as target - current value.
Check whether the complement exists in the hash map.
If the complement exists, return its stored index together with the current index.
If it does not exist, store the current value and its index in the hash map.
pseudocode: For each value and index in the array:
If complement exists in the hash map, return the stored index and current index.
Otherwise, store value and its index.
reasoning_steps: Return the two indices if found.
Otherwise store the current value and index.
Continue until a valid pair is found.

alternative_solutions.name: Brute Force
alternative_solutions.description: Check every pair of elements and return the indices of a pair whose sum equals the target.
